steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Special: ∫1/x dx = ln|x| + C, ∫eˣ dx = eˣ + C

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Trig: ∫sin x dx = -cos x + C, ∫cos x dx = sin x + C, ∫sec^2x dx = tan x + C

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Evaluate ∫₀^2 xsqrt(4 - x^2) dx using substitution u = 4 - x^2 --- Solution: u = 4 - x^2, du = -2x dx -> x dx = -½ du. Limits: x=0->u=4, x=2->u=0. ∫₄⁰ sqrtu (-½)du = ½∫₀⁴ u^½ du = ½[⅔u^⅔]₀⁴ = ⅓(8) = 8/3
